text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to Immunosuppression. Given the MRI findings of non-enhancing demyelinating lesions and confirmed ataxia, this diagnosis is strongly supported. Please confirm if you have a history of HIV/AIDS, recent chemotherapy, or are currently taking immunosuppressive medications like natalizumab.
